metadataRaw.title: How to INSTANTLY Relieve Quadratus Lumborum Pain
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe demonstrates how to quickly relieve quadratus lumborum (QL) muscle tightness and pain.

The QL muscle is a common source of lower back and hip pain, often affecting one side. This discomfort is typically caused by tightness and weakness.

To address this, the video is divided into two parts, focusing on stretching and strengthening the muscle for both immediate and long-lasting relief.

For the best results, go through all exercises and use what provides the most relief.

As a bonus, these exercises can be done at home and may offer quick pain relief—in as little as 30 SECONDS!

Watch now and say goodbye to quadratus lumborum pain!

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
1:06 Twist & Lean/Ballerina (Stretch)
3:49 QL Child's Pose (Stretch)
6:20 90-90 (Stretch)
8:20 Hip Raiser (Strengthening)
10:02 Hip Hiker (Strengthening)
